description: Rotating daily inspiration shown on the dashboard. Free members get scripture; paid members pick a category. Import TWENTY-THIRD (no dependencies)
notes: Selection is DETERMINISTIC, not random: index = dayOfYear % <count of active rows in that category>. Everyone sees the same item on the same day, and it does not change on refresh.
Set `pinned_date` to force a specific item on a specific day (holidays, launches). A pinned match always wins over the rotation.
`sort_index` gives the rotation a stable order. Without it the order depends on Baserow's default row ordering, which can shift when rows are edited.
`min_tier` gates a row: 'free' rows are visible to everyone, 'plus' rows only to paid members. Category access is enforced separately in the app.
The app ships a small bundled seed set as a fallback, so the dashboard still renders if this table is empty, unreachable, or not yet created.

body.description: The verse, quote, or affirmation itself

attribution.description: Speaker or author, e.g. 'Marcus Aurelius'. Empty for affirmations

source_url.description: Where it came from, for attribution and rights checking

sort_index.description: Stable position in the rotation within a category

pinned_date.description: Force this item on this exact date, overriding the rotation

active.description: Deactivate rather than delete, so the rotation stays reproducible
